messages:
maya: thinking about adding a "holdback" stage to config rollouts — a policy that automatically pauses traffic expansion if our latency/99th jumps >10% over baseline. would like opinions on API shape + console UX. :thinking:
aj: +1 on safety. we should gate the pause on a telemetry signal (latency/err rate) *and* a minimum sample size so we don't flake on noise. maybe two fields: `holdback_policy` and `holdback_conditions` in the runtime config.
example idea:
```json
{
  "rollout": {
    "stages": [
      {"pct": 1},
      {"pct": 10, "holdback_policy": "auto"}
    ]
  },
  "holdback_conditions": {
    "latency_pct_increase": 10,
    "min_requests": 500,
    "time_window_secs": 300
  }
}
```
aj: default `holdback_policy` could be `manual|auto|disabled`. auto = platform pauses stages and notifies on-call, manual = shows pause button in console only.
tom: console UX note — we need a clear affordance for operators to see why a rollout paused. show the metric delta and the sampled query ids that contributed to the signal. otherwise people will keep unpausing blindly.
li: implementation concern: where do we evaluate the condition? control plane (slow but easier) or in-proxy (fast, local)? my vote: eval in control plane with streaming telemetry hooks, but expose a local fast-fail override token for on-prem/private.
sam: how does this interact with `dry_run` and `shadow` modes? if `dry_run=true` we shouldn't pause production traffic obviously. maybe `holdback_policy` only applies when `enforce=true`.
maya: agreed. also suggest an ops API to acknowledge a holdback so humans can override after triage: `POST /rollouts/{id}/acknowledge_holdback` with reason. console should show a big yellow banner and an optional rollback button. :warning:
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout 1752468000 -> paused by auto-holdback (latency +12% over 5m, 620 reqs). @oncall paging :bell:
aj: small API nit — what should the telemetry contract be? we need consistent metric names and a stable baseline window. propose we use `baseline_window` and `signal_window` fields, defaults 1h and 5m.
maya: sounds good. i'll sketch an RFC for the API + minimal console mocks. can someone own the telemetry contract doc? @aj?
aj: I can. will PR a proto and a tiny console mock tomorrow.
tom: one more ask — add an audit trail field to rollouts so we can query historical holdbacks (`who`, `why`, `metrics`) for postmortems.
maya: yes — include `holdback_events` in the rollout resource. ok i'll open RFC in docs repo and tag eng-platform. thanks all. :party_parrot:
